'''Garouf Lafoe''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was an ice trader, fetching ice from the rings of [[Ohann]] and [[Adriana]], and bringing it back to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Garouf Lafoe}}</ref> Lafoe was a patron in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] took [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] there. After witnessing Obi-Wan swing a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at both [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] and [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]], he went outside and informed [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]] [[Davin Felth/Legends|Davin Felth]] of the incident.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garouf Lafoe was played by stuntman [[Peter Diamond]] in ''A New Hope''.<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> The original film cuts directly from Lafoe standing at the bar to him speaking to stormtroopers outside, but a rough-cut of the cantina scene released in various places includes extra footage of him actually waking away from the bar and exiting the cantina to find the troopers.<ref name="Complete Saga">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>

In the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'']] adaptation of ''A New Hope,'' this character was portrayed as a [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]].<ref name="SWMC 2">[[Star Wars (1977) 2|''Star Wars'' (1977) 2]]</ref>
